penny: Heads up 3 release-gate stopped the sample-app publish after a CI regen. I only reran the generator inside the CI container, didn't touch any API code. It claimed a breaking change in the API signature. Anyone seen false-positive semver flags from regenerations?
omar: ugh, paste the diff snippet if you can.

penny: small excerpt: ```diff
- func AddMember(ctx context.Context, teamID string, role Role, opts *AddMemberOpts) error
+ func AddMember(ctx context.Context, opts *AddMemberOpts, teamID string, role Role) error
```
lynn: looks like a pure reorder of parameters. our changelog classifier treated that as a signature change and triggered a semver major.
devex-bot: regen-report: file: sdk/go/teams.gen.go, changes: 1, classification: signature-diff, action: release-gate: BLOCKED
ci-bot: pipeline: typegen-check failed (exit 3): regen diff non-empty. full log: "changelog-diff: signature changed -> semver risk"
omar: we've seen this before when the generator's sort fallback used map iteration. CI container didn't have LANG set, so key ordering drifted.
lynn: short-term fix: run a stable regen locally or inside the CI image and commit the result. long-term we need deterministic keys in the generator and a changelog rule that recognizes reorder-only diffs.
penny: i'll try the local stable regen now: `make typegen-stable && git add -A && git commit -m "regen: stable parameter ordering" && git push`

penny: output: "INFO: stable sort applied
INFO: regen completed
INFO: diff empty"
devex-bot: re-run report: files changed: 0, potential-semver-change: 0, release-gate: PASS
lynn: nice. i'm going to open a tiny PR to add an explicit stable-key computation when metadata is missing (path, operationId|empty, parameterName). i'll also add a unit test that runs typegen with LANG unset and with a missing author field.
omar: also updating changelog heuristics: if parameter sets and types are identical and only ordering differs, classify as "reorder-only" and do not mark as a breaking change. will add a safety opt-in to manually force semantics if someone intends a reorder to be user-observable.
penny: quick note: during triage we noticed a separate flake in go-sdk auth/retry tests last week. that looked like a header ordering nondeterminism in the test harness. i'm going to normalize header maps in the tests to avoid parity flakes while we fix generator determinism.
lynn: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/701 3 adds deterministic fallback keys + LANG-matrix unit test. changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/134 adds reorder-only classification.
omar: CI re-run after penny's commit passed and publish proceeded. assigning follow-ups: lynn -> typegen PR, omar -> changelog PR, penny -> verify go-sdk auth tests.
devex-bot: note: scheduled nightly job to run typegen under multiple locales and with empty metadata set to catch regressions.
penny: thanks everyone, publish went out. closing thread. :tada:
